sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Stops the Google Play license check from blocking the patched app with a "Get this app from Play" screen.
Draws the navigation bar as a floating, translucent capsule with a sliding selection pill. Slide a finger along it to switch tabs. Liquid Glass blurs what's behind it.
Removes the floating Rovo Chat button, the Rovo icon in the issue header and the Rovo "Answers" block in search.
Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+): the accent color instead of Jira blue and tinted surfaces, in light and dark mode.
